name: nickbenes-marketplace
description: Nick Benes's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: claude-archive
plugins.description: Archive Claude chat history (claude.ai web chats and Claude Code sessions) to local Markdown/JSON, sorted chronologically

plugins.name: private-project
plugins.description: Set up a private, recurring conversation with Claude on sensitive topics (family health, finances, kids, therapy, job search) that runs through incognito chats and keeps its real record in a Google Drive folder instead of chat history

plugins.name: ops-center
plugins.description: Bootstrap and manage a persistent, filesystem-backed project workspace that lets independent Claude Code threads coordinate over time without shared conversational memory
